style_guide.voice: lowercase casual, no periods, short punchy lines, arrows for lists, no emojis, no em dashes, provocative questions, build-in-public energy, founder voice
style_guide.avoid: corporate speak, AI-powered, formal punctuation, long paragraphs, emojis, em dashes, exclamation marks

week_1.text:

> linkedin
> reddit
> x

writing a piece on why MCP is the new app store for advertising

the AI picks the tool, the user never sees alternatives

took 90 seconds

a human would spend 45 minutes clicking through linkedin's UI

google and meta will both ship AI campaign creation this year

neither will manage the other platform's campaigns

cross-platform is the moat nobody's talking about

ad agencies charge 15-20% of ad spend to manage campaigns

for a $100k/month budget that's $15-20k/month

for clicking buttons in a dashboard

AI agents do it better, faster, and for a fraction of the cost

the math is brutal

milestone: synter now manages campaigns across 7 platforms for paying customers

no agency, no dashboard hopping, just tell the AI what you want

still feels surreal
